page_title: FRE 3-2 WOL | Freiburg v Wolfsburg 13/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Celebrations are cut short for Freiburg as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was handball!
90+6' The Freiburg players halt their celebrations as referee Sascha Stegemann makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.
90+5' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) has a great chance inside the box and puts the ball into the back of the net.
90+4' A quickly taken corner by Wolfsburg.
90+2' Eren Dinkci (Freiburg) takes a short corner kick.
90+1' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' The manager makes a subsitution with Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg) coming on for Mohamed Amoura.

89' Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
88' Denis Vavro (Wolfsburg) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Sascha Stegemann ignores the protests.
86' That's the end of the game for Ritsu Doan, who is replaced by Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg).
85' Sascha Stegemann shows a yellow card to Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
85' Referee Sascha Stegemann points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Wolfsburg players celebrate.
84' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Wolfsburg players aren’t happy.
83' 3 - 2 What a GOAL! Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) connects perfectly with the ball in the box to score with a wonderful scissor kick. It’s now 3:2.
81' A dangerous looking corner kick from Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) is cleared to safety by the defence.
80' A substitution has been made. Kilian Fischer is replaced by Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg).
80' Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
79' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Freiburg.

78' What a save from Kamil Grabara! Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out. Freiburg earn a corner.
76' Max Rosenfelder (Freiburg) receives a yellow card for infringement.
75' 3 - 1 Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. What a clinical finish!
74' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 7:2.
70' Substitution. Christian Gunter makes his way off the pitch and Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) comes on as his replacement.
70' Vincenzo Grifo will be replaced by Merlin Rohl (Freiburg).
65' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
62' Julian Schuster has decided to make a change. Eren Dinkci (Freiburg) replaces Michael Gregoritsch.
62' The referee allows time for a substitution. Lukas Kubler will be replaced by Max Rosenfelder (Freiburg).

61' 3 - 0 Ritsu Doan sends a superb cross into the box. Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) latches on to it and from close range plants a header into the bottom left corner, leaving Kamil Grabara beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 3:0.
60' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
60' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Sascha Stegemann blows for a foul.
58' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
58' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) brings his opponent down. Sascha Stegemann has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
57' Ralph Hasenhuttl decides to make a substitution. Patrick Wimmer will be replaced by Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg).
57' Substitution. Bence Dardai is replaced by Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg).
57' A pass by Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
51' 2 - 0 GOAL! The corner comes over and Michael Gregoritsch wins a simple header before Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) nods the ball into the back of the net. 2:0.
51' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) takes the corner.
50' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Freiburg will take a corner kick.
50' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) is able to continue to play.
49' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
48' A precise low pass is received by Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the right post.
47' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Great save! Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Kamil Grabara.
46' Ralph Hasenhuttl makes a half-time substitution. Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) comes on in place of Tiago Tomas.
46' Referee Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) hits a shot towards the top right corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Kamil Grabara.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) rises high to connect with a cross from the corner kick, but his powerful header from near the penalty spot crashes against the crossbar!
45' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) is about to take a corner kick.
42' 1 - 0 Goal! Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the middle of the net. He makes it 1:0.
42' Corner kick. Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) is ready to send the ball into the box.
42' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Freiburg win a corner.
39' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
36' Bence Dardai (Wolfsburg) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
34' Flag up against Ritsu Doan (Freiburg). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
31' The foul by Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Sascha Stegemann.
31' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
29' Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) smashes the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after going way off target.
25' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

24' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat. The ball goes out of play. Wolfsburg are awarded a corner kick.

23' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the top right corner, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop his effort. The ball is out of play and Wolfsburg manage to earn a corner.
22' Sascha Stegemann shows a yellow card to Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) for a tough tackle.
19' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.

17' A big opportunity is wasted by Ritsu Doan (Freiburg), who makes a yard for himself and produces a mid-range rocket of a shot towards the bottom left corner. Unfortunately for him, Kamil Grabara pulls off a fantastic save to stop the effort.
16' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
15' Denis Vavro (Wolfsburg) leaps highest to meet the resulting set piece and sends his header way off target.
15' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) will deliver the corner kick.

13' Lovely run from Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg). He finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper, lines up a shot, but the keeper boldly launches himself to intercept the ball. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Wolfsburg.
12' Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
6' The resulting corner, taken by Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg), comes to nothing.
5' The ball is cleared after Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Freiburg have a corner.
5' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Wolfsburg will have the kick-off.
Sascha Stegemann is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
